title: Beer Bucket List: Scratch & Sip
tagline: For the beer enthusiast who's tired of just counting empty bottles. This scratch-off chart turns your quest for 99 different brews into a glorified bingo game. Perfect for the 'I'll try anything once' phase of your quarter-life crisis—just don't forget to actually drink the beer, not just scratch the chart.

title: Sneaky Sips in Style
tagline: For when your 'water bottle' is too conspicuous. This leather-clad flask is the perfect accomplice for your clandestine cocktail needs. Ideal for the office worker who needs a 'quick break' at 10 AM or the concert-goer who wants to avoid $12 beers. Just remember, it's a flask, not a time machine—don't blame us if you start singing show tunes at the wrong moment.

title: Link’s Hookshot for Your Keys
tagline: Tired of your keys playing hide-and-seek in the abyss of your bag? This Zelda hookshot keychain is here to save you from the daily dungeon crawl of fumbling for your house keys. Perfect for the adventurer who’s more likely to be rescuing their coffee order than a princess.

title: Turret In Your Pocket
tagline: Because you never know when you'll need to blind an intruder in your basement, this Portal turret flashlight is oddly practical for midnight snacking security patrols.

title: VHS Covers for Your Streaming Guilt
tagline: For those nights when you're binge-watching 'The Crown' but still want to feel like you're living in 1997. These VHS covers let you pretend your Netflix queue is a Blockbuster shelf. Perfect for confusing your grandma or making your roommate question your sanity. Just don't try to rewind them.

title: Coffee Stain Chic
tagline: For when you want to look like you just survived a caffeine-fueled study session at the campus library circa 1997. Perfect for your next 'I woke up like this' brunch or that awkward family reunion where your cousin asks why you still dress like it's the Clinton administration.

title: Snow Globe Apocalypse Fun
tagline: Because your desk needed a miniature wasteland, this snow globe brings post-apocalyptic chaos to your cubicle, complete with tiny ruins and a blizzard of desperation.

title: Tony Stark’s Junkyard Reboot
tagline: For when your mid-century modern aesthetic needs a superhero intervention. This Iron Man, forged from discarded metal, is the perfect centerpiece for your ‘I’m not a hoarder, I’m a collector’ phase. Ideal for the tech bro who wants to feel like he’s saving the planet while pretending to be a billionaire playboy philanthropist.

title: Globe for People Who Hate Flat Maps
tagline: Tired of your boring 2D world map? This 3D wooden globe is perfect for the cartography enthusiast who also happens to be a woodworker. It's like a puzzle, but instead of solving it, you just stare at it and feel accomplished. Ideal for the office of someone who says 'I could have been an explorer' while sipping their third coffee of the morning.

title: Jedi Up Your Tableware
tagline: Tired of your guests using their hands to wipe their mouths? Upgrade to these lightsaber napkin rings. Perfect for that one friend who insists on quoting Star Wars during dinner—now they can finally live out their fantasy of a civilized duel over who gets the last slice of pie.

title: The Wrench of Romance
tagline: For the man who’s always fixing something—except his love life. Perfect for that third date where you need to unscrew a stubborn bolt on her IKEA bookshelf while subtly signaling you’re handy with more than just a drill. Bonus: If she asks about the ring, you can say, 'It’s a metaphor.'

title: Post-Bender Enlightenment
tagline: For when you’ve drained the bottle but still need something to light your way through the existential dread of 3 AM. These candles turn your empties into a soft glow of self-reflection—perfect for the 'I should probably sleep but also need to stare at my ceiling' phase of the night.

title: Bone to Be Wild
tagline: Perfect for the goth who wants to skip the makeup and go straight to the existential crisis. Imagine showing up to a corporate Halloween party, only to realize you’re the only one who took 'dressing as your inner self' literally. Bonus points if you pair it with a coffee mug that says 'I’m just here for the free snacks.'

title: Mario's Lawn Ornament
tagline: Because your garden was missing a 6-inch Mario throwing fireballs, now it's complete. Imagine the looks when you're having a BBQ and Mario's casually torching Goombas on your lawn.

title: Smoke Signals 2.0
tagline: For the insomniac who needs to know if their roommate is secretly a wizard. This pipe glows like a nightlight for adults who refuse to grow up. Perfect for midnight philosophy sessions or convincing your cat you're a firefly. Just don't blame us if your landlord mistakes it for a neon sign.

title: Spare Brain for Bad Decisions
tagline: Perfect for those nights when you've had one too many and need to convince your friends you're actually a sentient pumpkin. Lightweight, recyclable, and guaranteed to make your Uber driver question life choices. Also great for scaring the cat when you forget to take it off before morning coffee.

title: Edible Fashion for the Hungry Soul
tagline: For when you're at a fancy dinner party but all you can think about is the pizza you left in the oven. This necklace lets you wear your cravings like a badge of honor. Perfect for the person who's 'too busy' to eat but never too busy to accessorize.

title: Santa's Got Back (Problems)
tagline: Is your holiday cheer tragically lacking in rhythmic pelvic thrusts? This Twerking Santa ensures your Christmas is... memorable. Perfect for passive-aggressively annoying your relatives or distracting the kids while you hide all the good presents for yourself. Because nothing says 'Merry Christmas' like a battery-powered Kris Kringle shaking his jelly belly.

title: Mug Shot Guaranteed
tagline: For when you want to threaten your coworkers with a felony charge over coffee, this mug is oddly perfect.

title: Sleep-Tracking for the Paranoid
tagline: For the hypochondriac who counts sheep while Googling their symptoms, this pillowcase turns your bed into a sleep lab. Track your tossing and turning with a built-in pressure sensor—because who needs a good night’s rest when you can obsess over your REM cycles instead? Perfect for convincing your doctor you’re *actually* a vampire.

title: Dentures? More Like Dentures-Do!
tagline: Forget the awkward first date where you both pretend to like the same obscure band. Now you can skip the small talk entirely and just flash your commitment level with this denture ring. Perfect for that third date where you want to say 'I love you' but also 'I might need to chew my steak later.'

title: Jurassic Leftovers
tagline: For when your paleo diet needs a *real* prehistoric touch. Perfect for the office desk of that one coworker who insists they're 'ancient soul incarnate.' Comes with a certificate of authenticity, because of course it does. Now you can finally prove to your cat that you're older than dirt—literally.

title: Shoe-Your-Own-Shoes
tagline: For the DIY enthusiast who's tired of stepping on Lego blocks. This book teaches you how to make shoes out of sushi, because why should your feet miss out on the fun? Perfect for that dinner party where you want to impress your guests by walking on your own creation—literally.

title: Tiny Wooden World for Your Finger
tagline: For when your GPS is too big. This miniature landscape ring lets you navigate your next hike—or at least impress your cat. Perfect for those 'I’m not lost, I’m just exploring' moments. Bonus: It’s the only real estate you can afford these days.

title: Game Boy's Second Career
tagline: For the retro gamer who also loves waking up to the sound of failure. This alarm clock mimics the Game Boy's iconic green screen, complete with pixelated numbers and a snooze button that works about as well as your childhood attempts at Tetris. Perfect for the adult who still thinks they can beat their high score in the morning.

title: Zombie Capitalism: Monopoly Edition
tagline: Ever wanted to buy Boardwalk while fending off a horde of walkers? Now you can! Perfect for game nights where your friends are already acting like the undead. Includes 'Quitter's Draw' cards for when someone inevitably rage-quits after landing on Free Parking for the third time. Just don't let the Governor catch you passing Go.

title: Literal Crap Gift, Delivered.
tagline: Need to express displeasure with, say, a neighbor's questionable lawn gnome collection? Skip the passive-aggressive note. Instead, *express* yourself with this. It's exactly what it sounds like. Actual poo, in a bag. Anonymously delivered catharsis for the modern age. Just… wash your hands afterward, okay?
